symbols.name: first space
symbols.meaning: The first of the two finite-dimensional vector spaces being tensored.
symbols.quote: The tensor product $E\otimes G$ of two finite-dimensional vector spaces $E$ and $G$ over the same field is a space of dimension $\dim E\cdot\dim G$ on which operators and bilinear forms of the two factors act factorwise.

symbols.name: second space
symbols.meaning: The second of the two finite-dimensional vector spaces being tensored.
symbols.quote: The tensor product $E\otimes G$ of two finite-dimensional vector spaces $E$ and $G$ over the same field is a space of dimension $\dim E\cdot\dim G$ on which operators and bilinear forms of the two factors act factorwise.

symbols.name: ambient space
symbols.meaning: A finite-dimensional space with a nondegenerate form, containing the subspace P.
symbols.quote: Let $A$ and $C$ be finite-dimensional spaces with nondegenerate forms, $P\subseteq A$ a subspace, and $Q\subseteq C$ a subspace.

symbols.name: second ambient space
symbols.meaning: A finite-dimensional space with a nondegenerate form, containing the subspace Q.
symbols.quote: Let $A$ and $C$ be finite-dimensional spaces with nondegenerate forms, $P\subseteq A$ a subspace, and $Q\subseteq C$ a subspace.

symbols.name: subspace of A
symbols.meaning: A subspace of A, later taken nondegenerate.
symbols.quote: Let $A$ and $C$ be finite-dimensional spaces with nondegenerate forms, $P\subseteq A$ a subspace, and $Q\subseteq C$ a subspace.

symbols.name: subspace of C
symbols.quote: Let $A$ and $C$ be finite-dimensional spaces with nondegenerate forms, $P\subseteq A$ a subspace, and $Q\subseteq C$ a subspace.

symbols.name: orthogonal complement
symbols.meaning: The orthogonal complement of P in A.
symbols.quote: Let $P$ be nondegenerate and $B=P^\perp$ its orthogonal complement in $A$, so $A=B\perp P$.

symbols.name: base space
symbols.meaning: A space of dimension h with a nondegenerate form, whose triple power is the label space.
symbols.quote: Take a space $F$ of dimension $h$ with a nondegenerate form.
